data.what_it_does: Provides a calendar week UI widget with support for custom date decorations, month view builder, and controller methods to navigate between weeks. It allows handling date press and long press events.
use_when: You need a dedicated calendar week view in your Flutter application
You want to mark specific dates with custom decorations and text
avoid_when: You need a full-month or multi-month grid calendar view
You require advanced scheduling and event management features out of the box
strengths: Provides a clean calendar week layout
Supports custom date decorations and month view builders
weaknesses: Limited to a single week view focus
Minimal built-in features beyond basic date selection and decoration
